title: Refactor: Migrate console.error in tool-registry.ts to coreEvents
body:
## Context
We are unifying our error reporting and user feedback. This file, `packages/core/src/tools/tool-registry.ts`, handles tool discovery.

## Task
Review the `console.error` calls within the `discoverAndRegisterToolsFromCommand` function.
- These are triggered when the user-configured tool discovery command fails. This is a true error that the user needs to be aware of so they can correct their configuration.
- Please migrate the `console.error` calls to use the event emitter: `coreEvents.emitFeedback('error', 'Tool discovery command failed.', errorObject)`. This will surface the error to the user in the chat history and log it appropriately.

Reference PR #11803 for examples.

Parent Issue: #10761
